extracted.summary: The scheme provides financial assistance to students belonging to the BC, EWS, and DNT communities of Sikkim studying at the post‑matric level.
extracted.amount_text: Group 1 professional courses provide INR 10,000 academic allowance and INR 10,000 tuition fees annually, INR 20,000 in total. Group 2 offers INR 8,000 and INR 5,000 respectively. Group 3 provides INR 6,000 and INR 2,000. Group 4 offers INR 5,000.
extracted.max_family_income_quote: Applicants must have an annual parent or guardian income of not more than INR 2,50,000 from all sources.
extracted.categories_quote: Applicants must belong to the BC, EWS or DNT communities.
extracted.states_quote: Applicants must be Indian nationals domiciled in Sikkim.
extracted.deadline_quote: 15th March 2024. The status shown on the page is Closed.
